spans.text: We used functional MRI to investigate CNS activation in response to visual food cues (pictures) and gustatory food cues (consumption of chocolate milk), comparing results with Ex9-39 versus placebo before and after RYGB.

caption.value: Effects of RYGB surgery and GLP-1 receptor blockade in response to visual and gustatory food cues

footer.value: This table describes the areas where significant differences in activations were observed for the different comparisons. First we describe the effect of RYGB, i.e., the difference in CNS responses before and after RYGB. Second, we describe the effect of RYGB on the effect of GLP-1 R blockade (GLP-1 R blockade × RYGB [before versus after]). For each comparison, the two contrasts for the visual food cues (activation during food >nonfood pictures and high-calorie food >nonfood pictures) and the contrast for the gustatory food cues (activation during chocolate >tasteless solution) are presented. The areas with significant differences are listed, including the cluster size of this effect, the t value, and the FWE-corrected P value after small volume correction (P-FWE). The last column describes the coordinates of the peak voxel of the observed difference in MNI space. For a stepwise interpretation of the results described in this table, please see Results. GLP-1 R, GLP-1 receptor; L, left; MNI, Montreal Neurological Institute; R, right; val, value.

description.value: Ten female candidates for Roux-en-Y gastric bypass surgery recruited from a bariatric surgery center.

value: Stable body weight during the previous month, defined as less than 5% reported change
Not on a formal calorie-restricted diet prior to or during the study
Use of any centrally acting agent

recruitment_method.value: Recruited from the Center for Bariatric Surgery at the Slotervaartziekenhuis in Amsterdam, the Netherlands.

medication_status.value: Three patients used antihypertensive medication, one used a cholesterol-lowering agent, and three used thyroxin for the treatment of hypothyroidism.

clinical_characteristics.value: Candidates for Roux-en-Y gastric bypass surgery with BMI >35 kg/m2; all participants underwent laparoscopic RYGB.

description.value: Block-design visual food-cue paradigm presenting high-calorie food, low-calorie food, and nonfood pictures during fasted and postprandial fMRI conditions.

stimuli.value: Pictures of high-calorie food, low-calorie food, and nonfood items; 42 pictures per category divided into six 21-second blocks.

description.value: Gustatory food-cue paradigm presenting chocolate milk or a tasteless solution, performed in the postprandial condition.

instructions.value: Keep the solution within the mouth for 6 seconds and refrain from swallowing until the sign 'swallow' was presented.

stimuli.value: Chocolate milk and tasteless solution delivered by programmable infusion pumps; orange triangle and blue star visual cues signaled the coupled solutions.
